description: Load active AgentLoop state and guard premature edits or completion.

hooks.command: python3 -c 'from pathlib import Path; import os,sys; versions=[p for p in Path(sys.argv[1]).parent.iterdir() if (p / "scripts" / "agentloop.py").is_file()]; latest=max(versions, key=lambda p: p.stat().st_mtime); os.execv(sys.executable, [sys.executable, str(latest / "scripts" / "agentloop.py"), *sys.argv[2:]])' "${PLUGIN_ROOT}" hook session-start

python3 -c 'from pathlib import Path; import os,sys; versions=[p for p in Path(sys.argv[1]).parent.iterdir() if (p / "scripts" / "agentloop.py").is_file()]; latest=max(versions, key=lambda p: p.stat().st_mtime); os.execv(sys.executable, [sys.executable, str(latest / "scripts" / "agentloop.py"), *sys.argv[2:]])' "${PLUGIN_ROOT}" hook pre-tool

python3 -c 'from pathlib import Path; import os,sys; versions=[p for p in Path(sys.argv[1]).parent.iterdir() if (p / "scripts" / "agentloop.py").is_file()]; latest=max(versions, key=lambda p: p.stat().st_mtime); os.execv(sys.executable, [sys.executable, str(latest / "scripts" / "agentloop.py"), *sys.argv[2:]])' "${PLUGIN_ROOT}" hook stop
